invariants.expression: b == 0 ? result == Integer.MIN_VALUE : result == a / b
invariants.rationale: Captures the main logic: if divisor is zero, return Integer.MIN_VALUE, otherwise return the integer division.
If b is not zero, the result must be equal to a / b.
If b is zero, only then the result is Integer.MIN_VALUE.
The only possible results are Integer.MIN_VALUE (when b == 0) or a / b.
